question: According to the 2011 Census of India, at all India level, the adult (15 + years) literacy rate is _________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 69.3 percent.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **adult literacy rate (15+ years) in India** as per the 2011 Census is 69.3 percent.
 
• The** overall literacy rate** in India, including all age groups, was 74.04 percent.
 
• There is a significant gender disparity in literacy rates, with** male literacy at 82.14** percent and **female literacy at 65.46 percent**.
